subject: Re: GlintAI pilot - extension and one-time burst top-up options
messages:
From: Aria Nguyen <aria.nguyen@glintai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot update — short extension and usage top-up options

Hi Connor,

Quick update from our side after the sprint last week — the team burned through more inference than we expected during the retrieval tests. We still see good signal, but we need another 2–3 weeks to complete the final integration tests. Two questions: 1) can we extend the current time-boxed pilot by 2 weeks (same scope) and 2) if we don’t want to extend the calendar, can we purchase a one-time burst top-up for additional tokens / concurrency to finish the tests?

We’re flexible on commercial structure but want something lightweight (no long-term commit). If you can share both a time-extension path and a top-up price for ~100k tokens (or an hourly burst pack) that’d help us decide today.

Thanks — copying Sam (ops) who will validate the usage numbers.

Best,
Aria Nguyen
Head of ML Ops
GlintAI

[Attachment: pilot_usage_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aria Nguyen <aria.nguyen@glintai.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@glintai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot update — short extension and usage top-up options

Hi Aria / Sam — thanks for the note and the usage file, that helped. Options below (kept simple):

Option A — 2-week calendar extension (no additional charge)
- Extend the existing pilot window by 14 days, same SLA and support level.
- No additional invoicing; we’ll keep the same time-boxed agreement.
- Purpose: if your burst is limited to integration runs and you anticipate <40% uplift.

Option B — One-time burst top-up (recommended if you need immediate capacity)
- Burst pack: 100k tokens pre-paid, usable within 30 days.
- List price: $1,200 for 100k tokens.
- Pilot partner discount: 25% off list => $900 (one-time invoice).
- Includes short-term elevated concurrency profile for the duration of consumption.

Option C — Short-term committed pack (convert to a small committed bucket)
- 3-month mini-commit (monthly billing) with deeper discounts — useful if you envision sustained usage after the pilot.
- I can send numbers if you’d like to explore.

Decision checklist: if you want us to preserve the same environment (no reprovisioning), choose Option A. If you need headroom immediately and want to avoid re-running integration job queues, choose B.

If you’re comfortable, we can proceed with Option B and I’ll route an addendum to Legal for a quick signature (DocuSign). If you prefer A, I’ll confirm with Marissa on the no-cost extension.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GlintAI pilot - extension and one-time burst top-up options

Connor / Priyom — forwarding Glint’s ask. I reviewed the usage summary: their burst was driven by a single parallelization experiment (one-off). I’m comfortable approving a one-time 25% partner discount on a 100k token burst pack if we keep the extension short and avoid precedent for free long extensions.

Recommended routing:
- Offer Option B (100k tokens at 25% off) plus a complimentary 7-day calendar extension (to let them finish any queued runs).
- Include a tight addendum (two paragraphs) describing: one-time burst usage, 30-day window, no convertibility to committed credit.

Priyom — can you draft the addendum PDF and route for e-signature? Keep it legal-light. Connor — if they accept, please get Sam’s confirmation on the usage numbers and send the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Marissa
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Internal note: keep margin above 40% on one-timers; don’t grandfather free long extensions]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aria Nguyen <aria.nguyen@glintai.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@glintai.com>

Subject: Re: GlintAI pilot - extension and one-time burst top-up options

Hi Aria / Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the usage file. We’re happy to support the finish line. Final offer below (keeps things simple and infra-light):

What we’ll do:
- 7 calendar day courtesy extension to the existing pilot (no charge).
- One-time burst pack: 100,000 tokens, valid for 30 days from purchase.
- Price: $900 (25% partner discount applied to list $1,200).

Terms summary:
- One-time purchase, non-refundable, not convertible into committed credits.
- Elevated concurrency settings for the duration of token consumption (will be scoped to your pilot cluster).
- We’ll attach a 1-page addendum; signing via DocuSign will finalize the purchase.

Next steps:
1) If you’re OK, reply-all with "Accept" and we’ll send the DocuSign link.
2) Connor will confirm the exact concurrency profile with your ops team.
3) Finance will issue a one-time invoice after signature.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-addendum
Attached: addendum-draft.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting you across the finish line.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Manager, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
